title: Lace-up Low-waisted Casual Wide-leg Pants
body_html:
Product Details

Design: 

  • Waistband: Wide elasticated low-rise waist with fabric front drawstring tie, fits snugly at low hip position
  • Pockets: Two oversized square cargo patch pockets on front hips, each decorated with metal snap button closure, outlined with thick contrast stitching
  • Side Detail: Vertical double rows of contrast decorative stitching running full length down outer leg seams
  • Silhouette: Slim fitted thigh gradually flaring into wide bootcut floor-length hem, classic 2000s retro flare shape
  • Fabric: Lightweight soft washed cotton twill, naturally crinkled casual texture
  •   Style: Y2K vintage street / Indie grunge casual / Skater aesthetic / Early 2000s retro daily wear 
  • Thickness: Light-medium breathable twill, suitable for spring, summer and early autumn 
  • Material: Wrinkle-resistant soft cotton twill, slight soft drape without stiffness 
  • Occasion: City street shooting, skate outings, campus daily outfits, retro themed gatherings, casual shopping trips
  •   Fit & Fabric:
  • Elasticity: High stretch elastic waistband; zero stretch leg fabric
  • Fit Type: Low-rise slim thigh flared bootcut relaxed fit

Size & Fit

Note

  1. Stretch drawstring waist accommodates multiple waist sizes; 2~3cm manual measurement deviation is normal.
  2. Thick contrast stitching + cargo snap pockets are core Y2K retro design highlights, recreating classic early-2000s aesthetic.
  3. Matching reference as pictured: cropped lime green tank top, canvas low-top sneakers; also compatible with baby tees, cropped hoodies, platform sandals and mini shoulder bags.
  4. Muted dark grey neutral tone easily pairs with pastel, black, white and khaki cropped tops for layered retro styling.
